initial_coolant: The measured y0±0.1K interval, common to every method.

methods.single_box: One continuous state and parameter box with every observation update.
methods.state_bank: Six initial-Tc intervals, full continuous heat-capacity uncertainty in each.
methods.parameter_bank: Same six Tc intervals crossed with three Cc and two Cn intervals:36 cells; continuous coverage unchanged.

criterion: Numerical comparison trajectories reach common robust invariant rectangles after a chosen wait and the command delay.
primary: Paired deadline gain over both single-box and same-state-partition baseline, independently generated continuous truths.
secondary: Set membership retention, unsafe delayed-transfer replay, CPU including filtering+ODE propagation, per-case gains/median and action approvals.
selection: All methods predeclared; no method/hyperparameter changes after confirmation. Development4x12 then confirmation12x12.
integration: RK4 step2s; 1s repeat on all confirmation queries; DOP853 independent plant at rtol1e-10/atol1e-11; finite3600s replay after transfer.
guarantee_scope: Analytic differential-comparison argument for stated continuous parameter intervals; implementation numerically validated, not outward-rounded or machine-certified.
source_relation: Extension of original two-temperature synthetic plant, not calibrated to OPENSC2 Case3.
